Part A:
Using inclusion-exclusion, the count divisible by at least one of 4, 6, or 9 is
1250 + 833 + 555 - 416 - 277 - 138 + 138 = 1945.
Among these, 149 are also divisible by 13, so the result is 1945 - 149 = 1796.

Part B:
Starting after 2026-10-24, counting weekdays and skipping the five listed holidays, the 84th business day is 2027-02-25.

Part C:
The relevant multiples of 7 are 7×43 through 7×1770. Subtracting those where the multiplier is divisible by 4:
7[(43+...+1770) - (44+48+...+1768)] = 8225280.

FINAL: 1796; 2027-02-25; 8225280
